functions.name: SCRAPE
functions.description: Scrape a URL with Anakin and return clean markdown. Submits the scrape job and polls until it completes or fails.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full URL of the page to scrape.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Use a headless browser — best for JS-heavy sites. Defaults to FALSE.

functions.name: SEARCH
functions.description: AI-powered web search with citations. Synchronous on Anakin's side (no polling). Costs 3 credits per call.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query or question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

functions.name: AGENTICSEARCH
functions.description: Run Anakin's multi-stage AI research pipeline (search, scrape citations, extract structured data) and return the AI-generated summary. Submits the job and polls until it completes or fails. Costs 10 credits.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The research question or topic.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Use a headless browser when scraping citation pages. Defaults to TRUE.

functions.name: MAP
functions.description: Discover all reachable URLs under a site. Submits the map job and polls until it completes or fails.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The starting URL for discovery (typically a homepage or section root).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of URLs to return overall. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many link-hops from the starting URL to follow. Defaults to 2.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Render with a headless browser — best for single-page apps. Defaults to FALSE.

functions.name: CRAWL
functions.description: Bulk-fetch markdown across a site. Submits the crawl job and polls until it completes or fails.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The starting URL.

parameters.name: maxPages
parameters.description: Hard cap on pages fetched. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Link-hops from the starting URL to follow. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Render each page in a headless browser — best for single-page apps. Defaults to FALSE.

functions.name: WIREDISCOVER
functions.description: Find Wire actions for a task from a natural-language intent. Wire is Anakin's catalog of pre-built automation actions across hundreds of websites. Synchronous — no polling.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The intent in natural language, e.g. "top phones on walmart".

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidate actions to return. Defaults to 5.

functions.name: WIRECATALOG
functions.description: Browse the Wire catalog. With no slug, lists every supported website and its action count. Pass a slug for that site's full action list with parameter schemas. Synchronous — no polling. Returns raw JSON since the response shape differs by call.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Catalog slug to inspect (e.g. "walmart"). Omit to list all catalogs.

functions.name: WIREREADACTION
functions.description: Run a Wire READ action (extracts data, no state change on the target site). Find action_ids and their param schemas with WIREDISCOVER / WIRECATALOG first. Transparently polls the job to completion. For WRITE actions, use the task pane's "Run a Wire write action" button instead.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The action to run (from WIREDISCOVER / WIRECATALOG).

parameters.name: paramsJson
parameters.description: The action's input parameters as a JSON object string, e.g. {"query":"iphone 15"}. Omit for actions that take none.

parameters.name: credentialId
parameters.description: Required when the action's auth_mode is "required"; honored when "optional". Get one from the Anakin dashboard.

functions.name: AIVISIBILITYSEARCH
functions.description: Ask multiple AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview) the same question and compare their answers. Submits the search and polls until it's no longer "running". Billed per source at that source's rate.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The question to ask every engine (max 2000 characters).

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated engine slugs to query (see AIVISIBILITYSOURCES). Omit to query all enabled engines.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter ISO country for the search geography. Defaults to "us".

functions.name: AIVISIBILITYSOURCES
functions.description: List the AI answer engines available to AIVISIBILITYSEARCH. Synchronous — no polling.

functions.name: SESSIONLIST
functions.description: List your saved browser sessions — encrypted login states used by SCRAPE/CRAWL (sessionId), monitors, and the task pane's browser-task button. Synchronous — no polling.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Filter to sessions for one website domain, e.g. "amazon.com".

functions.name: MONITORLIST
functions.description: List your website monitors, or pass an id to fetch one monitor's full configuration. Synchronous — no polling.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Monitor ID — fetch just this monitor instead of the full list.

functions.name: MONITORCHANGES
functions.description: Get the detected changes for a monitor. Find the monitor id with MONITORLIST first. Synchronous — no polling.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The monitor ID (from MONITORLIST).
